description: Bank: sixteen on/off buttons sent out as one polyphonic cable of gates

params.text: Turns that channel on or off; on sends the voltage chosen on the menu and off sends 0V

outputs.text: The sixteen button states after every expander in the chain has had its turn, one to a channel

notes: the buffer here holds gates, so an InX expander combines its input with the buttons by logical AND rather than by adding
menu: Voltage Range — sets the voltage a button sends when it is on: 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V or 0V-1V
Add Expander — places a ReX, InX or OutX expander on the correct side of this module
